meta.title: Made-to-measure Ao Dai — AODAI
meta.description: Design your own Ao Dai: choose the occasion, silhouette, fabric, colour, collar, sleeves, embroidery and measurements — with a live preview and instant quote.

title: Design your own Ao Dai
subtitle: Choose the occasion, silhouette, fabric and every detail — AODAI tailors finish it to your exact measurements.

occasion.title: Occasion
occasion.description: Pick an occasion and we pre-select a fitting silhouette, fabric and colour — you can still change everything below.

style.title: Silhouette
style.description: The cut defines how it feels to wear and the tailoring price.

fabric.title: Fabric
fabric.description: Sourced from craft villages — each fabric drapes and shines differently.

color.title: Colour
color.description: Trousers are matched in a softer tone to flatter the dress.

details.title: Collar, sleeves & length
details.description: The small details that make the silhouette yours.

decoration.title: Pattern & embellishment
decoration.description: Hand embroidery and beading are handmade and take extra time.

pants.title: Trousers / skirt
pants.description: Tailored in a matching fabric and tone.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.description: Choose how you would like to give your measurements.

timeline.title: Timing & notes
timeline.description: Timing includes one fitting and alterations.

labels.notesPlaceholder: E.g. a more fitted waist, lower side slits, initials embroidered on the cuff…
